findings.summary: Manifest diff is a pure append and the two new PNG bytes match their manifest OutputHash entries.
findings.detail: `git diff --numstat tests/ArrTags.Tests/Goldens/manifest.json` is `20 0` (20 insertions, no deletions) and the diff context shows the two new entries appended after `center` with every existing entry untouched. `git status --short tests/ArrTags.Tests/Goldens/` lists only `M manifest.json` plus the two untracked new PNGs; no existing PNG is in the diff. `sha256sum` of the committed bytes returns 3affb2e6...e7f9 for bottom-left-extra-large.png and 26b96cd1...fbda for full-rail-extra-large.png, matching the manifest OutputHash values case-insensitively. `git diff --stat src/` is empty.
evidence: git status --short -> only manifest.json modified, two new PNGs untracked
findings.recommended_action: none; the append-only invariant and hash identity hold.

findings.summary: The Extra Large fingerprints are genuinely non-default and differ from the same-input Medium counterparts; version constants did not advance.
findings.detail: Both new fixtures use the same source and metadata as an existing Medium golden with only the size differing, so the comparison isolates the size input. bottom-left-extra-large fingerprint A21E1D03...CD3E1 vs rgb-png (same TechnicalMetadata + default BottomLeft/Medium) 34C828D8...1D53; full-rail-extra-large 6E30E536...D18CF11 vs full-rail (same FullRailMetadata + default BottomLeft/Medium) 40FC8147...3DBAE6, and the PNG hashes differ too. `RenderFingerprint.AppendBadgePlacement` and `RendererConfigurationFingerprint.AppendBadgePlacement` append badgeSize only when Size != Medium, confirming the difference is the non-default size. The focused native oracle compares result.OutputFingerprint to the manifest value, so the actual ExtraLarge fingerprint equals the committed manifest entry. `RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion` is 3 and `RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion` is 2, and `git diff --stat src/` is empty, so neither advanced.
findings.recommended_action: none; ADR-027 clause 4 version decision is correctly verified.

findings.summary: The explicit in-process determinism check extends only bottom-left-extra-large; full-rail-extra-large determinism rests on the golden oracle.
findings.detail: RenderDeterminismTests.RepeatedRendersAreByteIdentical adds only bottom-left-extra-large. full-rail-extra-large is covered by the golden oracle, which renders it fresh and requires byte, hash, fingerprint, and exact decoded-pixel equality with the committed artifact; the committed bytes were produced by two generator processes. This is adequate coverage of the acceptance criterion, just not a second explicit repeat-render case.
findings.recommended_action: none required; adding full-rail-extra-large to the determinism test would be harmless but is not needed for the criterion.

findings.summary: The shipped golden code has no writer or auto-approval path; the only File.Write in the determinism files is the pre-existing temp-file process probe.
findings.detail: No File.Write*/StreamWriter/auto-approve/update-golden match exists in RenderGoldenFixtures.cs, RenderGoldenTests.cs, or RendererCrossRuntimeTests.cs. RenderDeterminismProcessProbe.cs writes the rendered PNG only to the ARRTAGS_DETERMINISM_PROBE_OUT temp path in a fresh process for the parent to compare (pre-existing task 4.11 code), never to the committed Goldens directory; GoldenStore only reads.
evidence: grep File.Write|StreamWriter|auto-approve in golden test files -> no matches
findings.recommended_action: none; fails closed with no writer path over committed goldens.
